summary: Tianci International (Nasdaq: CIIT) filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing a cryptocurrency mining machine hosting agreement between its wholly owned subsidiary Tianci Group Holding Limited and BTC Digital Ltd. (Nasdaq: BTCT). BTCT will provide hosting, installation and testing, and ongoing operations and maintenance services for mining machines the Company recently contracted to purchase, and will assist connecting the equipment to United States operating infrastructure. No monetary terms, pricing, capacity figures, contract duration, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is an ordinary commercial services contract and not a special-situations event; the parties may evaluate additional hosting capacity. Watch execution risk on equipment deployment and counterparty dependence on BTCT.
